title: Change Integration Simulator: mergeability is not verification
audience: Reviewers who need exact source/target simulation without moving refs or confusing a clean merge with a passing behavior gate.
promise: Pin commits, simulate clean and conflict outcomes, run a separately identified local gate, and leave the branches untouched.
story: A clean source/target pair resolves to a merge tree with exact commit identities.
A conflicting pair reports the shared file and produces no merge tree.
A local whitespace gate is recorded against the target commit as a separate probe.
Stale movement, cancellation, retained workspaces, and remote CI remain explicit limits.
verified_locally: Current-dev clean merge-tree receipt records source, target, merge base, tree identity, and output hash.
Current-dev conflict receipt names the conflicting file without changing refs.
A separate local gate probe is bound to the target commit, and pre/post source/target ref readbacks remain unchanged.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass; the 1600x900 PNG/SVG preview was visually reviewed.
open_gates: Bind a real Workflow Gateboard receipt to the simulated state.
Exercise stale, cancellation, and retained-workspace boundaries with explicit negative readbacks.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and read back the external destinations.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a current-dev local clean/conflict simulation slice, a separate gate probe, ref safety, and a reviewed 1600x900 preview; it does not claim integrated Gateboard execution, remote CI, hosting, or publication.
